authors_reviews.title: Lasts long, great for emergencies, AWESOME BUILT IN TYPE C LANYARD!!!
authors_reviews.text: I wanted to put this charger through some use before making a review and I think enough time has passed. Here are my thoughts.The packaging and the instruction booklet are excellent. The English and grammar used are correct and proper. I appreciate that.I have an iPhone 13 mini. This power pack charger really helps me get through the day. I get many charges out of it before having to recharge the pack. This charger does run a little hot when magnetically charging my iPhone, but I think that’s normal. It has a lanyard with a built-in Type C cord, which I think is very clever and convenient. The way they made it actually holds the weight of the pack very securely. The lanyard cord is not going to come apart and drop the pack.The power pack is a bit bulky on my iPhone 13 mini, but I don’t really use the phone when it’s attached. This power pack is really for emergency purposes and just helps me get through the day or when I forget to charge.The build quality is decent, constructed of orange anodized aluminum and plastic with a digital display of the battery percentage. It has 2 type C ports. You can plug into either port and it recharges. It does what it needs to do.There are 3 negative points I wanna mention about this charger. These are just my opinions.1. I must mention that the case surface is quite SLIPPERY. There are no silicone or rubberized feet or dots to prevent it from sliding off of a surface and it’s going to get scratched up easily.2. There was a day when the battery percentage of the power pack was at 46% and my phone was at 14%. I attached it magnetically to the iPhone and it sat for a good 45 minutes, but did not charge! The iPhone showed that it was connected and that it was charging, but my iPhone stayed at 14% the whole time. I wiped the surfaces, made sure it was magnetically seated correctly, but it still wouldn’t work. The power pack was warm indicating that it was doing something, but battery percentage on my iPhone never went up so I don’t know what the deal was with that. This only happened one time. After recharging the power pack it now works normally. I’ve used this product a total of 12 times.3. There is a corner that is kind of lifting up off of the casing. I don’t know if that is the battery swelling up inside or if it is just a lack of glue in that area. I noticed this when I first opened the package. It has not gotten worst and has been holding up well.If you have an iPhone 13 mini and you’re looking for a MagSafe pack to keep attached to your phone throughout the day, while using ur phone, then I believe there are more slimmer and compact designs available for that purpose. This is bulky and heavy.Thank you for reading my review.
authors_reviews.author: Rick O.

authors_reviews.title: Slim MagSafe Power Bank with Strong Magnet and Helpful Display
authors_reviews.text: This MagSafe power bank is a convenient option for keeping your phone charged while traveling or on the go. The slim design makes it easy to carry in a bag or pocket, and the magnetic connection attaches securely to the back of the phone.One feature I really like is that the charging cord is integrated into the design and doubles as a handle. It makes the power bank easier to hold or carry without worrying about losing a separate cable. The cord can also be detached and used for wired charging when needed, which adds flexibility depending on how you prefer to charge your device.The magnetic connection is strong and holds the power bank firmly in place while charging. It aligns well with MagSafe-compatible phones, which makes wireless charging simple and convenient without having to plug anything in. This is especially useful when you are moving around or using your phone while it charges.From a functionality standpoint, the power bank performs well for quick charging throughout the day. It works both as a wireless charger through the magnetic connection and as a wired charger using the built-in cable, which gives you two charging options in one device. This makes it practical for travel, commuting, or situations where you need to quickly top off your phone’s battery.Another helpful feature is the digital display that shows the exact percentage of charge remaining in the power bank. This makes it easy to see how much battery is available instead of guessing based on small indicator lights.Overall, this is a well-designed portable charger. The slim profile, strong magnetic connection, built-in cord handle, multiple charging options, and clear battery percentage display make it a practical power bank for everyday use or travel.
authors_reviews.author: SDPreston

authors_reviews.title: Beautiful power bank that works like a charm. Excellent build and aesthetic quality.
authors_reviews.text: Never knew a day would come that I would fall in love with a battery pack. Absolutely beautiful piece of kit and works like a charm. I like it better than my samsung s25 ultra. Its compact, very well finished and of excellent build quality. The Clementine orange is beautiful. It seems to be made of metal with a beautiful satin finish. The small indicator on the edge is excellent. The strap you see in the picture is actually a USB c to USB c cable. Excellent design, cable is the lanyard.I do not need the cable thought as i attach it to my phone via magsafe. The system works like a charm, the moment it is attached, fast charging is initiated. Charging works fine, no heat or other such problems.This is not my first INIU product. I have bought other INIU products in the past and always had a nice experience. I once bought a chargeable light and have been looking for another ever since as my wife wanted it but it never came back on sale.This is a beautiful gadget/charger, very well made. Guarantee on box says 3 years. Thats a long enough time for me.I love products made of metal in clementine orange so that is a bonus for me.I wish all power banks came with LED light and a fm radio, both very cheap to add but will make the power bank an excellent utility item. Just an idea, nothing to do with this power bank.I wholeheartedly would recommend this power bank as it is 10 out of 10 in all departments as far as I am concerned.

The color on the charger perfectly matches my Orange iPhone 17 Prob with its perfectly colored metallic back. Both wired and wireless it is able to quickly get me back to a full charge in under an hour from maybe 20% sometimes. authors_reviews.title: Strong magnet, useful display, a little warm
authors_reviews.text: The magnet snaps onto my iPhone firmly enough that I could walk around the house with it attached and not feel like it was about to slide off. Charging started right away, which is exactly what I wanted from a magnetic battery pack.I used this at my desk during a long workday and again over the weekend while doing stuff in the garage. The battery percentage display is a lot more useful than the usual tiny LED dots. I could actually tell how much charge was left instead of guessing. Wired charging through USB C is clearly faster than wireless, but the wireless side is convenient when I just want to stick it on and keep using my phone.For a 10000mAh pack, the size feels reasonable, though I would not call it tiny. It is slim enough to carry, but you still notice the weight when it is hanging off the phone. Build quality feels solid, almost a little more premium than I expected, and the attached USB C cable doubling as a strap is handy. One small thing, it does get warm during wireless charging. Mine never got alarmingly hot, but it is noticeable.I am giving it 5 stars because it does what it claims, charges fast, and is easy to live with. Just know there is no USB A port, and if you are sensitive to bulk, that is worth considering.

other_countries_reviews.title: Posiblemente la mejor
other_countries_reviews.text: Para tener 10.000mAh, la batería tiene un tamaño y peso apenas superior a las normales de 5000mAh. Sí es algo más delgada que otras de 10000mAh que uso. De longitud es unos 2mm más larga que otras que tengo de la misma capacidad. Pero son diferencias apenas imperceptibles. El peso también es lo esperado en una batería así. No molesta demasiado en una mochila o incluso bolsillo. Tiene un botón de encendido, que a su vez activa una pantalla led, que indica en todo momento el nivel de carga restante de la batería. Y un buen detalle: viene una correa de hilo para colgarla de la muñeca o mochila, a la que está enganchada una muñequera que en realidad es un cable plano USB-C a USB-C extraíble. No molesta para nada y me parece una idea muy práctica para llevar siempre a mano un cable, por si se desea cargar otros dispositivo que no tenga carga inalámbrica. Tiene además dos puertos USB-C, que la hacen muy versátil. Se carga en menos de 1 hora usando uno de ellos, si se conecta a un cargador rápido de 65W.Pero lo mejor y por lo que al menos la pedí yo: su tecnología Qi2.2, que promete control de temperatura, junto a carga de 45W por cable y 25W inalámbrica. La más rápida que he tenido. Y no puedo dejar de comentar el color naranja de este modelo. Combina perfectamente con el iPhone 17 Pro o Pro Max Cosmic Orange, sobretodo en la parte exterior que queda a la vista cuando la batería está pegada al móvil. Esa parte tiene un acabado que asemeja al aluminio del terminal. La parte interna del powerbank es de acabado algo más de plástico, con un tono naranja un poco más suave.He querido probarla bien unos cuantos días, antes de escribir mi reseña. Y tras una semana usándola durante el día trabajando, casi siempre en el coche o taxis, para recargar mi iPhone en desplazamientos, en viajes de avión Barcelona - Madrid, en un fin de semana completo con el mismo móvil y cargando también un iPad Pro de 11'' y el Poco x7 Pro de mi mujer, confirmo que la carga se hace a las velocidades de carga máximas (sobretodo con la batería del dispositivo por debajo del 50%). Y lo que más me ha gustado: que con la carga inalámbrica en el iPhone, no hay un sobrecalentamiento, como si he sufrido en otras powerbank con soporte de magsafe. Estando cargando más de 30 minutos, apenas se siente algo tibia de temperatura. Y de hecho, en 30-25 minutos me carga de un 26% a un 80% el iPhone 17 de manera inalámbrica. Una maravilla. Y he verificado podría hacer unas 2.5 cargas completas del iPhone 17.Me parece una fabulosa powerbank, de calidad, completa y con la mayor velocidad de carga inalámbrica disponible hoy en día. Además este color naranja se ve espectacular. Obviamente todo esto hace que el precio sea algo más elevado que otras. Pero si buscas lo mejor, no te lo pienses.

other_countries_reviews.title: One Day In — Already Proven Its Worth
other_countries_reviews.text: **Note:** I've only had this power bank for one day, so consider this an early impression. I plan to update this review over time, since power banks can be hit or miss in the long run.Let me tell you why I bought this thing. I hate the two-handed juggling act of holding a phone in one hand and a dangling power bank in the other. My whole goal was to find something that magnetically attaches to my phone and essentially becomes part of it — one clean object. With that in mind, wireless charging speed wasn't really my concern. What I cared about was: how fast does it charge my phone, how fast does it recharge itself, how strong are the magnets, how hot does it get, and how does it feel in hand. So that's the lens I'm reviewing this through.First thing worth mentioning — it arrived a day early. Not sure if that's Amazon or INIU, but either way, a nice start.I'm using this with a Google Pixel 9 and a magnetic case. Before heading out, I ran a quick test at home and took my phone from 20% to 80% in about 35 minutes. I can't verify the exact wattage, but that felt fast and encouraging. After that I topped up the power bank itself using a fast-charging brick, and within a few hours it was back to 100%. That kind of quick turnaround matters if you're grabbing it on your way out the door.Speaking of heading out — the real test came at the bar. I was genuinely excited to show off the orange colorway (yes, I went orange), and almost immediately a friend needed a charge. He's on an iPhone, so I handed him the cable rather than relying on wireless — faster that way. His phone went from 16% to 60% in around 30 minutes. While it was charging, I touched the power bank expecting it to be warm. Nothing. Cool to the touch. I was genuinely impressed.Then a second person asked to use it. Of course. By the time I got it back it was sitting at about 50%. So to recap: two people charged their phones to roughly 60% each, and the power bank still had half its capacity left. For a slim, pocket-friendly unit, that's exactly the kind of real-world performance I was hoping for.Now, the magnets. They're strong — noticeably so. I can hold the power bank and let my phone hang from it without any concern. It's not going anywhere. That magnetic connection is the whole point of buying something like this, and INIU delivered.The only minor gripe I have is that the metal back panel is a little slippery. It's not a dealbreaker at all — and honestly, if that smooth metal surface is what's keeping this thing cool, I'll take the trade-off every single time. A slightly slippery power bank beats a hot one, no contest.One more thing worth noting: it doesn't appear to support pass-through charging, meaning you can't charge the power bank and your phone simultaneously. That's not a concern for me personally, but if that's a feature you rely on, keep it in mind.One day in, I'm impressed. More to come.**Note** I used Claude Ai to help we write this review. I'm dyslexic and my god ai has been a god send for me. Anyway, just wanted to let y'all know.

other_countries_reviews.title: Exzellent und sehr durchdacht
other_countries_reviews.text: Diese Powerbank für Magsafe-kompatible Smartphones ist die Wucht: sie liefert Leistung pur auf kleinem Raum und funktioniert als drahtloser Charger richtig gut. Das wertige Metallgehäuse des Testgeräts passt farblich perfekt zu den neuesten orangen iPhone 17 Pro Max (in "Cosmic Orange"). Natürlich gibt es die Powerbank auch in anderen Farben, und sie funktioniert auch mit allen anderen Smartphones, die Magsafe-kompatibel sind.Bei älteren Smartphones sollte man deshalb vorher genauer hinsehen: iPhones unterstützen MagSafe zum Beispiel erst ab iPhone 12. Bei älteren Geräten fehlen schlicht die intern ringförmig angeordneten Magnete, die für den Halt der Powerbank sorgen und sie präzise ausrichten, damit die drahtlose Energieübertragung reibungslos funktioniert. Besitzt man noch MagSafe-inkompatible Geräte, kann man MagSafe-fähige Handyhüllen nachrüsten.Jedenfalls sind die Zeiten nun vorbei, wo ein fast leerer Akku zu Panikattacken oder Kabelsalat mit klassischen Powerbanks führt: einfach diese Powerbank magnetisch aufsetzen, und schon lädt das Handy und kann quasi endlos weiterbenutzt werden. Diese Powerbank liefert mit 10000mAh genügend Energie für mehrmaliges Aufladen, ist dadurch aber auch etwas dicker und schwerer. 5000mAh-Powerbänke sind zwar etwas leichter, mit den hier gebotenen 10000mAh lassen sich indes auch mehrere Geräte nacheinander (oder gleichzeitig per USB-C-Kabel) auftanken.Für die hohe Leistung ist diese Powerbank erstaunlich schlank und bringt nur rund 200g auf die Waage. Andere Powerbanks mit ähnlicher Leistung sind häufig deutlich klobiger (eher 300g) und kommen oft in billig wirkenden Kunststoffgehäusen. Das ist hier anders: die aufgesetzte Powerbank sieht am iPhone 17 Pro Max fast so aus, als sei sie ein Original Apple Zubehörteil.Ein entscheidender Punkt bei drahtlosen Powerbanks ist die Ladegeschwindigkeit. Diese Powerbank kann ein modernes iPhone drahtlos mit 25W laden. Konkret unterstützt sie Qi2 mit 5/7,5/10/15/25W. Ältere Smartphones, die noch keine 25W Ladegeschwindigkeit unterstützen, laden entsprechend langsamer.Die Powerbank selbst lässt sich per USB-PD mit bis zu 45W aufladen. Dazu ist ein USB-C-zu-C-Kabel und ein USB-PD-Netzteil nötig. An USB-A und/oder einem simplen USB-Charger lädt sie nur mit 5V/5W. Das gilt übrigens anfangs auch für USB-C, aber schon nach kurzer Zeit schaltet die Powerbank dann in leistungsfähigere Lade-Modi hoch.Die Designer dieser Powerbank haben sich viele clevere Lösungen einfallen lassen: so verfügt die Powerbank nicht nur an der Seite über eine integrierte Digitalanzeige für den Akkustand, sondern die an sich bereits praktische Halteschlaufe kann nicht nur leicht gelöst werden, sondern entpuppt sich dann als USB-C-zu-C-Schnell-Ladekabel. So hat man auch für das drahtgestützte Laden (mit bis zu 45W) oder für das Aufladen der Powerbank immer das passende Kabel dabei.An den beiden USB-C-Buchsen stehen alle gebräuchlichen Schnell-Ladeprotokolle zur Verfügung, unter anderem SCP mit bis zu 22W sowie QC4.0. Unterstützt werden außerdem fünf USB PD-Profile mit bis zu 45W an. Zur Verfügung stehen 5/9/12/15V mit bis zu 3A sowie ein PPS-Profil (5-11V mit bis zu 4,5A). Im "Mischbetrieb", wenn mehrere Geräte gleichzeitig drahtlos und drahtgebunden aufgeladen werden, reduziert die Powerbank die drahtlose Ladeleistung von maximal 25W auf maximal 15W.Fazit: eine wirklich tolle Powerbank: hohe Ladeleistung, genügend Kapazität für mehrmaliges vollständiges Aufladen (oder Aufladen mehrerer Handys nacheinander), dabei (relativ) klein, leicht und handlich, mit als Halteschlaufe umfunktionierten USB-C-Ladekabel, präsentiert in einem schicken Metallgehäuse, das perfekt zu der neuesten iPhone 17-Generation passt. Besser kann man sowas kaum machen.
